figurative_meaning_en: As transient as water on a lotus leaf
similar_in_english: Like water off a duck's back
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বন্ধুত্ব নলিনীদলগতজলদবত্তরলম্, কোনো সময়ই স্থায়ী হয় না।
জীবনের সুখ নলিনীদলগতজলদবত্তরলম্, তাড়াতাড়ি চলে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: His friendship is as transient as water on a lotus leaf, never lasting long.
The joys of life are as fleeting as water on a lotus leaf, slipping away quickly.
history: This compound word originates from classical Sanskrit literature, often used to exemplify elaborate linguistic constructions in works like those of Kalidasa, symbolizing impermanence in Indian philosophical traditions.
note: Recognized as one of the longest compound words in Bengali and Sanskrit, highlighting linguistic complexity.
